Coram : PANKAJ MITHAL, SANDEEP MEHTA
Issue for Consideration Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) rejected the application of the appellant for the listing of certain equity shares to the BSE holding that the appellant had not taken in principle approval from the Stock Exchange and it also did not take the approval of the shareholders for the Private Limited (RARE). Order upheld and confirmed by the Securities Appellate Tribunal.
